articles.title: US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after attempted attack on American troops
articles.description: After a short period of relative calm when hostilities were paused, both sides have now restarted missile attacks.
articles.titleJa: 米国、米軍への攻撃未遂後にイランへ「大規模」攻撃を開始
articles.summary: 米国は米軍に対する攻撃未遂を受け、イランへの大規模な報復攻撃を開始した。一時的に停止していた両国間の敵対行為とミサイル攻撃が再開されている。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war

articles.title: Missile that left crater deep inside Poland was probably Russian - Polish PM
articles.description: The missile left a 10m-wide (33ft) crater a short distance from the village of Tarnawa Kolonia, about 100km from the border with Ukraine.

articles.summary: ポーランド首相は、国内に10mのクレーターを残したミサイルが恐らくロシア製だと発表。ウクライナ国境から約100kmのタルナワ・コロニア村近くに着弾した。

articles.title: Nicaraguan leader proposes extending presidential term by another year
articles.description: It is not the first time the constitution has been amended to allow Daniel Ortega, 80, to stay in power for longer.

articles.title: Veteran Ugandan opposition leader collapses in court and in ICU, his wife says

articles.titleJa: ウガンダのベテラン野党指導者が法廷で倒れ、集中治療室に―妻が発表
articles.summary: ウガンダのベテラン野党指導者（70歳）が法廷で倒れ、集中治療室に入院したと妻が発表。彼は2024年11月から拘留され、国家反逆罪の容疑を否認している。

articles.title: Zendaya on working with Tom Holland in Spider-Man: ‘When you’re best friends it’s easy’

articles.titleJa: ゼンデイヤ、トム・ホランドとのスパイダーマンでの共演について：「親友なら簡単よ」
articles.summary: ゼンデイヤがトム・ホランドとのスパイダーマン最新作での共演について語り、「親友だから簡単」とコメント。二人はロンドンプレミアに登場した。

articles.title: Trump considering AI controls after OpenAI hacking incidents

articles.title: Singapore fines French teen $465 for viral straw-licking stunt

articles.summary: シンガポールで、SNSで話題になったストロー舐めいたずらを行ったフランス人19歳の若者に465ドルの罰金が科された。彼の弁護士は本人が「本当に申し訳ない」と述べている。

articles.title: Australia takes Telegram to court over alleged failure to remove 'pro-terror' material
articles.description: Telegram told the BBC it rejects the allegations and will contest them in court.
articles.titleJa: オーストラリア、電報（Telegram）が「テロ支持」資料削除を怠ったとして提訴
articles.summary: オーストラリア政府は、Telegramが「テロ支持」と見なされる資料の削除を怠ったとして同社を提訴した。Telegramは容疑を否定し、法廷で争う構えを示している。

articles.title: Germany's heat death toll nears 10,000
articles.description: Germany's heat-related death toll for 2026 has already surpassed every full-year total since 2016 — and is expected to climb as another spell of extreme temperatures takes hold.

articles.summary: ドイツが犯罪歴のない男性をアフガニスタンへ強制送還。同様の運命を恐れる人々もいる。

articles.title: Why Germany may stand up against FIFA's World Cup sell off
articles.description: Leading figures in German football have lined up to criticize Gianni Infantino’s plans to sell a stake in the World Cup. Germany is showing signs that they may ready to oppose Infantino's re-election.

articles.summary: ドイツサッカー界の主要人物がFIFAのワールドカップ売却計画を批判。インファンティーノ会長の再選に反対する動きも。

articles.title: Poland says Russian ballistic missile violated airspace
articles.description: Polish authorities have said that a Russian ballistic missile crashed within its borders during Moscow's overnight attacks on Ukraine. No injuries were reported as Kyiv warned air defense in the region needs boosting.
articles.titleJa: ポーランド、ロシアの弾道ミサイルが領空侵犯と発表
articles.summary: ロシアがウクライナへの夜間攻撃中に発射した弾道ミサイルがポーランド領内に墜落したと発表された。負傷者なし。

articles.title: Danube water levels: Hungary, Romania cut nuclear output
articles.description: Historically low water levels along Europe's second-longest river have led Hungary and Romania to reduce output at key nuclear plants. Danube tourism and river cargo have also been severely affected by Europe's heatwave.

articles.summary: ドナウ川の水位低下により、ハンガリーとルーマニアが原子力発電所の出力を削減。観光や貨物輸送にも影響。

articles.description: Wildfires on the Greek island of Crete are forcing thousands of residents and tourists to evacuate. Three firefighters have died as Greece becomes the latest country, after France and Spain, to face summer blazes.

articles.summary: ギリシャのクレタ島で山火事が発生し、数千人が避難。消防士3名が死亡。

articles.title: UEFA set for emergency meeting on FIFA World Cup proposal
articles.description: UEFA is reportedly soon to hold an emergency meeting to discuss FIFA's plans to effectively sell off a stake in the World Cup. European football's governing body has expressed stiff opposition to the plan.

articles.summary: UEFAがFIFAのワールドカップ株式売却案を議論するため緊急会議を開催すると報じられた。

articles.summary: ヴァーグナーのオペラ「リエンツィ」は、AI生成による「ニーベルングの指環」を巡る議論も相まって、現代でも物議を醸している。

articles.description: It's more than a copyright issue: The flood of AI-generated tracks is unfair competition for the original creators, says GEMA.

articles.summary: AI生成音楽の著作権について、ドイツで訴訟が提起された。GEMAはオリジナル作成者への不公平な競争だと主張。

articles.title: Fifteen elephant deaths at Kenya park may be due to cyanide poisoning
articles.description:
Analysis of samples collected from carcasses found traces of toxic chemical compound, says Kenya Wildlife Service
The recent deaths of 15 elephants near a park in southern Kenya in the past month were likely caused by the animals ingesting pesticides used on nearby tomato farms, the Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS) has said.
Erustus Kanga, the agency’s director general, told Citizen TV that analysis of samples collected from the carcasses had found traces of cyanide, a chemical compound used in farming as a predator control poison and a pest fumigant, also used by poachers.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ケニアの公園でゾウ15頭が死亡、シアン化物中毒の可能性
articles.summary: ケニア南部の公園でゾウ15頭が死亡し、死骸からシアン化物の痕跡が発見された。近くのトマト農場で使用された農薬を摂取した可能性があり、ケニア野生生物局が調査中。

articles.title: Record absence of world’s oldest head of state reignites health speculation
articles.description:
Cameroon’s president has not made statement or been seen since leaving for ‘brief private stay’ at Swiss hotel on 7 June
A record 53-day absence of the world’s oldest head of state has renewed speculation in his native Cameroon about whether he is dead or alive, even though discussing his health is illegal in the country.
On 7 June, 93-year-old Paul Biya departed for Switzerland for what officials described as a “brief private stay” alongside his wife, Chantal. Almost two months later, neither the president nor the first lady have addressed the country or been seen publicly.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 世界最高齢の国家元首が記録的な不在、健康に関する憶測が再燃
articles.summary: カメルーンの93歳ポール・ビヤ大統領が53日間公の場に姿を見せず、健康状態に関する憶測が国内で再燃している。スイスでの「短期滞在」とされていたが、約2ヶ月間消息不明。

articles.title: A quarter of young Africans believe USAID cuts could be positive, survey finds
articles.description:
Losing funds should force leaders to confront their own challenges, they said, while many voiced concerns over increasing foreign influence 
A quarter of young Africans believe aid cuts by the US could have a positive impact, saying that losing foreign money will force leaders to confront and solve their own challenges, according to a new survey.
In Ghana and Nigeria, almost half (41% and 40% respectively) of young people aged 18 to 24 were optimistic, with Liberia not far behind (37%). A further one in 10 (11%) young people were uncertain about the impact, according to the African Youth Survey, which interviewed almost 5,000 people across 16 of the continent’s 54 recognised countries.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: アフリカの若者の4分の1が、USADの援助削減がプラスになると信じているとの調査結果
articles.summary: 新しい調査によると、アフリカの若者の4分の1が、米国の援助削減はリーダーが自国の課題に直面し解決を迫られるため、ポジティブな影響をもたらすと考えている。特にガーナとナイジェリアで楽観的。

articles.title: Kenya investigating unexpected deaths of 15 elephants in national park
articles.description:
Potential toxic substance detected in several of 15 elephants found dead in Kenya’s Amboseli national park

Officials are investigating the deaths of 15 elephants over the past month in Kenya’s Amboseli national park.
The Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS) said 10 of the elephants showed signs of partial paralysis before dying within two days.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ケニアでゾウ15頭が不審死、国立公園で調査中
articles.summary: ケニアのアンボセリ国立公園で過去1ヶ月間にゾウ15頭が死亡した原因を当局が調査している。一部のゾウからは麻痺の兆候が見られ、毒物の可能性が指摘されている。

articles.title: Uganda begins emergency food handouts after 19 die from hunger
articles.description:
Government move follows months of drought and crop failures in Karamoja, with 1.5m people facing malnutrition
Uganda has launched emergency food relief distribution after at least 19 deaths from hunger were reported in an area of prolonged drought in the east of the country.
A crisis has been building in the Karamoja region of Uganda as crops have failed without the season’s expected rains, leaving the region’s 1.5 million people facing acute food shortages and rising malnutrition.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ウガンダ、飢餓で19人が死亡を受け緊急食糧援助を開始
articles.summary: ウガンダ東部のカラモジャ地域で、数ヶ月にわたる干ばつと作物不作により19人が飢餓で死亡。政府は150万人が栄養失調に直面する中、緊急食糧援助の配布を開始した。

articles.title: Canadians spent $3.3bn less on travel to US in 2025 after Trump’s return to office
articles.description:
Data shows Canadians have replaced US vacations with other international trips in apparent rebuke to Trump
Canadians spent $3.3bn less on travel to the US in 2025 than in the previous year, as Donald Trump’s hostile policies towards his northern neighbour continue to incur an economic cost, new government data shows.
The research also indicates that Canadians are not bucking travel overall and instead have replaced US vacations with other international destinations, in a rebuke to Trump’s tariff regime and the president’s continued musings on annexing Canada.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: トランプ再選後、2025年にカナダ人の米国旅行支出が33億ドル減少
articles.summary: ドナルド・トランプ氏の再選後、カナダ人の米国旅行支出が2025年に33億ドル減少した。カナダ人は米国への旅行を控え、他の国際目的地に切り替えており、トランプ氏の政策への反発を示している。

articles.title: Past fires suggest effects of Europe and North America wildfires may linger for years
articles.description:
Three years after Maui wildfires many still struggle with ‘biological, emotional and social consequences’, study says
A spate of ferocious wildfires across North America and Europe, worsened by the climate crisis, has incinerated homes and forests and forced thousands of people to flee. Previous fires suggest the effects of these blazes may linger for years to come.
The current fires and their plumes of smoke can appear to be a temporary, if immediate, crisis. Nearly 1,000 fires have sprung into life in the boreal forests of Canada, causing the evacuation of towns and toxic smoke to waft into major Canadian and US cities, prompting threats of retribution from Donald Trump, who bizarrely accused Canada of “poisoning” his country’s air.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: 過去の事例が示す、ヨーロッパと北米の山火事の影響は数年間続く可能性
articles.summary: 気候危機により悪化した北米とヨーロッパでの激しい山火事の影響は、数年間続く可能性がある。カナダの森林火災は米国都市にも煙を及ぼし、避難者も多数。

articles.title: Javier Milei accuses US Democrats of financing ‘anti-Argentina campaign’ at World Cup
articles.description:
President also blames Brazil and Mexico and says online critics ‘do not want the ideas of freedom to succeed’
More than a week has passed since Ferran Torres scored the extra-time goal that gave Spain its second World Cup, but – at least for Argentina’s president – the tournament is not over.
Javier Milei has claimed that a coordinated “anti-Argentina campaign” was behind criticism of the country’s team, accusations of racism among its fans and conspiracy theories alleging that Lionel Messi’s side was secretly being favoured by Fifa.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ハビエル・ミレイ、ワールドカップでの「反アルゼンチン・キャンペーン」は米国民主党が資金提供と非難
articles.summary: アルゼンチンのハビエル・ミレイ大統領は、ワールドカップでのアルゼンチン代表への批判が「反アルゼンチン・キャンペーン」の一環であり、米国民主党が資金提供していると非難した。

articles.title: Pinochet-era soldier jailed for killing folk singer Víctor Jara 53 years ago
articles.description:
Nelson Haase Mazzei was sentenced for murdering Jara in 2023, but fled from authorities in Chile
More than 50 years after the murder of the Chilean folk singer Víctor Jara, the last man wanted in connection with his death has been tracked down and brought to justice.
Nelson Haase Mazzei, a retired colonel, fled from authorities in 2023 after he and six other retired soldiers were sentenced in absentia for murdering Jara and another man.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: ピノチェト政権時代の兵士、53年前にフォーク歌手ビクトル・ハラ殺害で投獄
articles.summary: チリのフォーク歌手ビクトル・ハラ殺害から50年以上を経て、最後の容疑者である元兵士ネルソン・ハーセ・マッセイが逮捕・投獄された。彼は2023年に有罪判決を受け、当局から逃亡していた。

articles.title: Shots fired near US consulate in Canada for second time in four months
articles.description:
No one was injured and no suspects have been identified in connection to shooting near Toronto compound, police say
Shots were fired near the US consulate in Toronto early on Monday but no one was injured in the second shooting near the diplomatic compound in four months.
“Officers heard a firearm being discharged in the area,” and “a white sedan was seen fleeing the scene”, Toronto police said on X.
 Continue reading...
articles.titleJa: カナダの米国領事館付近で4ヶ月で2度目の発砲事件
articles.summary: トロントの米国領事館付近で月曜早朝に発砲事件が発生したが、負傷者はいなかった。同じ外交施設付近で4ヶ月に2度目の発砲で、警察は白いセダンが逃走したのを目撃している。

articles.title: A decade of growth: From headline figures to everyday change

articles.summary: ウズベキスタンでは10年間の経済改革が投資、雇用、金融を再構築。その恩恵が企業や家計に届いているかが焦点となっている。

articles.title: Invasive mould infections are more common than thought, study finds
articles.description: A new study suggests invasive mould infections are a bigger and more common health risk than previously thought.

articles.summary: 新しい研究により、侵襲性真菌感染症が以前考えられていたよりも大きな、より一般的な健康リスクであることが示唆された。

articles.title: Japan shopping mall explosion after 7.1 quake captured on dashcam footage
articles.description: Dashcam footage shows a shopping mall explosion after a 7.1-magnitude earthquake hit Kumamoto, Japan, as rescuers search for survivors.

articles.description: As wildfires continue to ravage parts of southern Europe, the celebrity couple say they have “no idea” whether their French property will survive.

articles.title: Seven dead after helicopter crashes during firefighting mission in Argentina

articles.title: Bank of England holds interest rates at 3.75% despite inflation risks
articles.description: Although UK inflation fell in June, the Bank of England held interest rates steady as renewed conflict in the Middle East and volatile energy prices clouded the outlook.

articles.title: Crete wildfire kills two firefighters as fierce flames spread in Greece

articles.title: 'Crude language of MAGA’: Author Joyce Carol Oates defends 'The Odyssey' after translator's scathing review

articles.titleJa: 「MAGAの粗野な言葉」：翻訳者の辛辣な批評を受け、作家ジョイス・キャロル・オーツが『オデッセイ』を擁護
articles.summary: クリストファー・ノーラン監督の『オデッセイ』を巡る文化論争が続く中、翻訳者の酷評に対し、作家ジョイス・キャロル・オーツが作品を擁護した。

articles.title: EU expected to probe Balkan construction material imports over suspected Chinese tariff-dodging
articles.description: There are growing suspicions that certain open mesh fabrics are being made with Chinese glass fibre already hit by EU anti-dumping and anti-subsidy duties for unfair pricing and state support.

articles.title: Canadian intern of Chinese origin appeals Belgian pre-trial detention regarding spy charge
